usage.batter_start_share_by_rank_note: share of team games started by the k-th most-started batter, full-season teams; ranks sum to ~9
usage.weekend_start_note: full-season teams; rank = team's k-th most frequent weekend starter, ranks >= 8 pooled; series game = order of the team's Fri-Sun games within the calendar week (third and later pooled)

team_talent._note: Team strength on the log-runs scale (quasi-Poisson fit of runs on team offense o, run prevention d and the home slot; (o, d) = tier mean + conference effect + team effect, noise removed by method of moments). NCAA scoreboard feed, every 2025 D1-vs-D1 final (data/ncaa_2025/scoreboard/games_2025.csv; fetched for PR #1).
team_talent.src: NCAA scoreboard feed, every 2025 D1-vs-D1 final (data/ncaa_2025/scoreboard/games_2025.csv; fetched for PR #1)

parks._note: Park effect of the listed home team's park, log runs per game, from the scoreboard fit with a park term; tier means relative to the D1 average park, SDs within tier with estimation noise removed (method of moments).
